component.name: Lekhani Latex
component.summary: A modern LaTeX editor with live PDF preview

description.p: Lekhani Latex is a cross-platform desktop LaTeX editor with a live PDF preview, syntax highlighting and command autocompletion. It supports multiple open documents, undo and redo, automatic compilation on save, and zoomable page-by-page preview navigation.
Compilation uses the local TeX distribution (for example TeX Live or MiKTeX), while the inline preview uses mutool, Ghostscript or pdftoppm when one of them is available.
